name: canvas__scheduling_mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for scheduling: an outside agent finds providers and open times, and, when the operator lists the patient and write tools, finds a patient, reads their appointments, and books, reschedules, and cancels. It serves the Agent Development Kit's standard tools over one SimpleAPI route, authenticated by a bearer key.

handlers.description: The MCP endpoint: JSON-RPC over HTTP POST at /mcp
